remarks: Beautifully updated Cape Cod-style home in a prime Norwalk location-just minutes to shopping, dining, the Merritt Parkway, and I-95. This turnkey gem offers modern comfort with timeless charm, beginning with a welcoming front porch featuring new Trex decking-perfect for morning coffee. Step inside to bright, open-concept living spaces accented by hardwood floors throughout and filled with natural light. The stylish kitchen and living areas flow seamlessly, creating an ideal environment for both everyday living and entertaining. Central air ensures year-round comfort. The main level boasts a convenient first-floor primary bedroom, the home offers an additional 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and a dedicated office-ideal for working from home. Thoughtful storage solutions include knee wall storage in both upstairs bedrooms and generous closet space throughout. The finished basement provides additional living space, perfect for a family room, fitness area, or playroom, and also includes ample storage and laundry. Recent upgrades include a new driveway and stone wall with steps (2020), as well as a charming white picket fence added in 2020. The 1-car under-house garage and level yard complete the package. The back deck is ideal for evening grilling and relaxing, surrounded by lovely hydrangeas that enhance the home's curb appeal. This home blends character, comfort, and convenience in one perfect Norwalk location-don't miss the opportunity to make it yours!
